clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind Keep, Donyal Tovald tends the Royal Library’s historical works. Under an initiative sponsored by young King Anduin Wrynn, he preserves and copies books for wider public use.

Donyal Tovald tends the Royal Library’s collection in Stormwind Keep. The library holds historical accounts, scrolls, and scholarly volumes, chiefly for the nobility and royal court. Young King Anduin Wrynn has sponsored an effort to make that knowledge more accessible to ordinary citizens. Tovald preserves and copies the texts, helping keep the Alliance’s lessons and triumphs recorded amid the kingdom’s political troubles.
